text:
zoe (marketing): Quick sync  we want to land the Adaptive Routing announcement the week of Apr 6. Need final changelog link, canonical docs URL, a one-paragraph benchmark blurb for the blog, and exact rollout timing so we can schedule the announcement + webinar.

rahul (eng): Changelog branch is live. There's a tiny API addition: `routing_policy` accepts `type: 'latency' | 'cost' | 'hybrid'` now. Non-default behavior only when explicitly set. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/changelog/pulls/911

kelly (docs): I can prepare the docs and FAQ. Please paste the minimal request examples and the migration note for pinned models.

rahul (eng): Example request we'll publish: \n```\nPOST /v1/infer \n{\n  "model": "rwd-adaptive-v1",\n  "routing_policy": { "type": "hybrid", "max_latency_ms": 110 }\n}\n```\nMigration note: if customers pin `model: rwd-standard` they won't get adaptive decisions; to opt in set `routing_policy` or remove pin.

tan (product): For messaging: lead with reliability and predictable costs. Marketing want a short benchmark line: p95 improvement and cost-per-request reduction. Keep claims conservative.

rahul (eng): Internal perf run (filtered): p95 baseline 130ms -> adaptive 108ms (~17%); throughput (rps) +8% at same GPU config; estimated cost per 10k tokens down ~12%. I'll attach run details in the PR.

zoe (marketing): That works. Can we get one-line press copy + a 2-sentence explainer for the blog? Also need docs URL ready at canary start so we can link from the landing page.

leo (sales): Heads up: Sales will need a SFDC field to tag webinar attendees and early access requests. Can ops set a webhook to toggle an 'early_access' flag?

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: job #deploy-175666 for 2026-04-05T22:00:00Z. Canary: eu-west-1 3% for 3 hours, then 25% global ramp.

rahul (eng): Proposed canary policy for runbook: `canary: percent=3 duration=3h health=[error_rate,p95_latency] rollback:on(error_rate>0.7% OR p95>baseline*1.25)`

kelly (docs): I'll stage the page at https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/adaptive-routing (staged). I can set it to publish automatically when deploy-bot posts the canary start event. Need the final curl/example and the canary snippet to embed.

zoe (marketing): Webinar: Apr 8, 10am PT. Speakers: tan + rahul + customer. Slides: 1 slide bench, 1 slide migration steps, 1 slide rollback/canary plan. Please drop a 1-paragraph bench blurb I can use in the blog.

rahul (eng): Draft blurb: "In internal tests across real-world web traces, Adaptive Routing reduced p95 latency by ~17% and improved throughput while lowering per-token spend by ~12%, thanks to smarter routing and adaptive cache utilization."

tan (product): Good. Marketing tweak: change "per-token spend" to "per-token cost" and add "typical web workloads".

zoe (marketing): Updated blurb request: one sentence for the banner, one sentence for the blog. Also need short FAQ: dedicated customers data residency and how rollouts are scoped per pool.

leo (sales): For inbound routing: Sales wants a landing page hidden field to mark 'interested_in_canary'. Can ops/email team wire a hook to auto-create lead with that tag?

rahul (eng): Ops can set the webhook. Also adding a small snippet to the changelog about migration and the new `routing_policy` enum.

kelly (docs): Once rahul merges the PR I'll merge the docs and schedule publish at canary start. I'll comment here with the final live link.

deploy-bot: Canary will start 2026-04-05T22:00:00Z in eu-west-1.

zoe (marketing): Perfect. I'll draft the blog + landing page and post draft copy by EOD Wednesday. Please react with :eyes: when changelog/docs PRs are merged so I can lock copy.

rahul (eng): will ping when merged.

tan (product): I'll notify CS to prioritize onboarding requests from the webinar and add a recommended playbook for gating.

zoe (marketing): Thanks everyone. If anything changes on timing or canary policy, call it out here immediately. :sparkles:
